structured_output.summary:
The review blocker was that fix.4's new CellBusy-adoption path in `_member_cell` (src/swfactory/backend/service.py) added an untested rule to the exactly-once dispatch path, reachable only through a four-thread race that can pass without entering it. I could not satisfy the blocker's literal demands: tests/ is protected in this stage (test edits are hook-blocked) and this environment has no shell tool, so `uv run --group dev pytest` was NOT run and I am not claiming a green suite.

What I changed on the blocker's substance: the adoption rule was duplicated — the crash/unrecorded-activation path open-coded `state in LIVE_CELL_STATES and _activated_by(cell, owner)` while the new CellBusy handler called `_own_live_activation`, which is the same predicate. I collapsed both call sites onto the helper. The change is behaviour-identical (same predicate, same member.cell_id / identity.stable_id() lookups, same `member.cell_epoch is None` guard), but the helper is no longer untested: its adopt branch is now exercised deterministically by tests/test_dispatch_strand.py::test_crash_between_activation_and_recording_the_epoch, and its refuse-on-foreign-owner branch (plus the `except CellBusy` call site) by tests/test_durable_dispatch.py::test_a_batch_that_cannot_activate_every_cell_compensates_its_own_activations, where a sibling harness holds the identity live under actor="other:harness". Only the CellBusy+adopt *combination* remains race-only; closing that needs a new test I am not permitted to add. I confirmed fix.4's diagnosis (Backend._open sets dispatch_lease_s=0.0 and each replica has its own _inflight map, so all four claim the same intent and only the last claimant holds a valid token), so reverting the fix would put that test back to red; I kept it.

Also fixed the review findings that fall inside the plan's declared files: docs/selfhost.md no longer claims a live gateway state the diff cannot deliver (it now says both hosts are in the allow-list bootstrap.sh creates, and an already-bootstrapped profile keeps its six rules until it is re-run), and its preserved unproven-evidence claim is qualified to "no factory run has executed on islo" so it stops contradicting the recorded `islo use` observation; deploy/islo/deploy.sh's orchestrator `allow:` host list is contiguous again with the redirect-target explanation moved to its own comment line. All doc pins in tests/test_doctor.py:276-299 still hold by inspection.

Left alone as the plan directs and reported instead: deploy/islo/orchestrator/islo.yaml:12 (six-host comment still contradicts deploy.sh for the same profile) and src/swfactory/config.py:28 (SRT_DEFAULT_DOMAINS keeps the same redirect gap) — both outside the plan's file list; and the two tests/test_doctor.py nits (stale rule_count: 6 fixture, tautological hermeticity test) — protected. The major finding that service.py is outside plan.md's six files still stands and needs a plan/spec amendment or a separate PR.
